title: Chronicle Cards: tokenizer & Figma automation for temporal cost timelines
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a set of reusable 'Chronicle Card' components and a lightweight Figma plugin that tokenizes and stitches variants across density scales for Redwood Console timelines and cost views. Goals: 1) Produce a single source component that supports snapshot, delta, and granular-activity states for dashboards and rollouts; 2) Ensure token mapping for spacing, elevation, color and motion is canonical and easy to sync with runtime token exports; 3) Automate bulk migration of existing timeline cards in the Console Figma file via a plugin that annotates token diffs and prepares exportable spec artifacts for engineers. This ticket covers prototype review, accessibility checks, and a compatibility strategy for Console metrics and rollout inspector integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined and documented for Chronicle Card variants (compact, standard, expanded)
Figma plugin prototype can apply token mappings to 100 existing timeline cards in the Console file without breaking constraints
Accessible contrast and keyboard focus states validated against WCAG 2.1 AA
Design spec + handoff exported to engineering including CSS token map and example snapshots for runtime-1.23 rollout integration
Migration plan with list of dependent components and a canary subset for staged replacement
